hook: Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including you.
caption:
Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including you.

Ask ChatGPT to help you plan a project and it'll give you a 5-step framework with bullet points and a friendly sign-off.

Ask your coworker. Ask your competitor. Ask your mom.

Same. Five. Steps.

Here's what's actually happening: AI defaults to the most statistically average version of helpful. Which means it's perfectly mediocre for everyone instead of genuinely useful for anyone.

The person who thinks in systems gets the same response as the person who thinks in stories. The big-picture visionary gets the same response as the detail-obsessed executor.

And then we all sit there wondering why the output feels... off. Like advice from someone who kind of knows you but not really.

That's not an AI problem. That's a calibration problem.

When AI actually knows how you process information — whether you need the why before the what, whether you want options or just a decision, whether bullet points help you or overwhelm you — the output stops feeling generic.

It starts feeling like it was written for you.

Because it was.

BootFile builds that profile. So your AI finally has context that matters.
